capabilities: Move the suggester selection down one item
Move the suggester selection up one item
Enable linking to headings and blocks of non-first matching files on mobile
disambiguation: It does not add a new suggester; it only adds commands that control the existing link suggester selection on mobile.
extras: Must be installed manually by copying main.js and manifest.json into the plugin folder; the README references an example usage video that is not included in the text.
motivation: The author uses markdown links and has multiple same-named files in different folders, and needed a way on mobile to pick a non-first entry and then reference headings or blocks like on desktop.
problem: On mobile, selecting a file from the link suggester immediately converts the link to a markdown link, so you cannot navigate the list to link to a heading or block of a file that is not the first match.
summary: Set of three commands that move the wiki-link suggester selection up or down and confirm it, for use on the mobile toolbar.
